skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 80% ATK damage to a single target. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Corrupt] on the target for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 180% ATK damage to a single target.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK damage to a single target.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After being hit, has a 25% chance to increase own damage by 10% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After being hit, has a 25% chance to increase own damage by 15% for 1 turn.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After being hit, has a 25% chance to increase own damage by 18% for 1 turn.
